goal: Implement Slice S4 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): Assurance snapshot capture, capability minting and verdict application move into one host-neutral module in runtime/assurance; both hosts adopt the stricter existing checks and supply only AssuranceHostPort and a confirmation reference.

acceptance.assertion: Per D4 and invariant I2 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U1, U2): one host-neutral module captures the Assurance snapshot for both hosts. Positive: a TaskRecord matching the projection is captured. Negative: a mismatch in record_revision, in intent_snapshot.revision, or in intent_ref.content_hash each refuses with 'TaskRecord changed before assurance snapshot capture'. Bound: a v4 record without git_base_head refuses. Agreed seam: tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts.

Per the D4 sequence of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U2, E3): verdict application verifies the snapshot, mints the capability, runs beforeCommit, then commits. Positive: an approval records approval and a rework verdict requests rework and stages the planning-artifact transition. Negative: a snapshot that changed is refused with 'assurance snapshot changed before authority application' before any capability is minted. Bound: when onCommit throws, afterCommit still runs, the first error is rethrown and the committed transition stands. These hold for a Claude-configured and a Pi-configured coordinator. Agreed seams: tests/host-neutral-assurance-coordinator.test.ts, tests/review-revision-identity-conformance.test.ts.

Per D4 and invariant I1 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (source E1): AssuranceCoordinatorPorts has no per-host buildAssurance, ensureReviewRevision or applyVerdict; a host supplies AssuranceHostPort and a confirmation-reference source only. Claude capabilities carry claude:<actor>; Pi capabilities carry pi-confirm-<16 hex>. Pi host notification stays in the Pi adapter. Existing assertions in the named suites are not weakened. Agreed seams: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts, tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
